key.name: block-during-session
key.summary: Block distracting sites while a session runs
key.description: Apply the blocklist automatically whenever a study session is counting down, and lift it when the session is paused or stopped.

key.name: drop-connections
key.summary: Drop live connections when blocking starts
key.description: Tear down existing connections to the blocked sites as the block goes up. Without this a tab that is already talking to a site keeps working on its open connection, since reloading it never looks the name up again. Connections to addresses shared with other services (most Google properties) are dropped too, and reconnect straight away.

key.name: manual-block
key.description: Keep the blocklist applied regardless of the timer. Mirrors the "Block distracting sites" switch in the panel menu.
